info.name: Couchbase Documents API
info.description:
Operations tagged Documents across 2 of this provider's published API definitions: couchbase-capella-app-services-public-api-openapi.yml, couchbase-sync-gateway-public-rest-api-openapi.yml. Each path carries the servers of the definition it was published in.
